tiebreakers.description: Tie goes to the player who started later in turn order (the player to the starting player's right wins all ties).

notes: Game ends after each player has taken 16 turns. Resolve scoring in rulebook order: plazas first, then academics, Hunger Wall/Cathedral rows, corner tokens, walls, final abilities, eggs. Seal abilities can convert gold/stone into points (2 per gold or stone, max 18; 3 per gold+stone pair); V tiles can score per upgrade tile, wall, gold mine, quarry, Charles University height etc. - enter their total in finalAbilities. Solo variant (beat 140 points) not modelled.
